purpose_es: Simulación didáctica: señal absoluta, ruido absoluto fijo y un componente. La envolvente de relajación es ilustrativa; omite otros intervalos, eficiencia STE, acoplamiento J, flujo y deriva. No es una simulación completa de espín ni una validación del instrumento.
purpose_en: Teaching simulation: absolute signal, fixed absolute noise and one component. The relaxation envelope is illustrative; other delays, STE efficiency, J coupling, flow and drift are omitted. It is not a full spin simulation or hardware validation.
gradient_calibration: Hypothetical Gmax=0.5 T/m. Not the PLA BBO calibration or the protected TBO calibration.
kernel_scope: Ideal bipolar smoothed-square teaching model. Timing convention must be checked against each acquired sequence. D21/LED/double-STE are discussed separately, not represented by this single-STE kernel.
normalization: Absolute S/M0 is plotted. R means S(g=96%)/S(g=8%) for the same timing; SNR uses noiseless expected signal divided by the fixed noise sigma. No negative noisy values are removed.
noise: The same seeded Gaussian noise realization is retained across animation frames for visual comparison; frames are not repeated acquisitions.
